profiles.scope: Lanmodulin family: lanthanide binding/handling, not a membrane importer or proof of lanthanide-dependent growth. Canonical C5B164 passes inherited GA.

Landiscernin lanthanide-chaperone domain. Binding and LanM interaction supported; physiological sorting/export model remains proposed. Canonical C5B159 passes GA despite an obsolete generic UniProt description.

WtpA substrate-binding family; W-preferred Mo/W uptake. Source explicitly restricts this model to selected archaeal homologs; not a universal WtpA detector. NF003196 was not added because it recognizes the same six reference WtpA proteins.
WtpABC permease family. Mo/W scope; does not alone prove a complete transporter or W-only specificity. P. furiosus Q8U4K4 passes inherited GA.
WtpABC ATP-binding family; not generic ABC evidence for tungsten transport. P. furiosus Q8U4K3 passes inherited GA.

Restricted TupA coverage: C. jejuni Q0P885=487.3 passes GA400, but characterized D. alaskensis Q316W1=356.8 and P. acidaminophilum Q93KD6=235.5 fail. No cutoff relaxation. Negative detection is not evidence of absence of tungsten acquisition.
TupABC permease family; C. jejuni Q0P886 passes inherited GA. Related Vup-associated reference sequences do not pass; not an independent population specificity benchmark.
TupABC ATP-binding family; C. jejuni Q0P887 passes inherited GA. A lone ATPase hit does not establish a complete transporter.

excluded_redundant_candidate: NF003196.0: same six reviewed WtpA references as TIGR03730.1; not claimed identical HMMs
